COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
CRLA No.298 of 2026
Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Hon’ble Siddhartha Sah, J.
Mr. Priyanshu Gairola, learned Legal Aid Counsel 
for the appellant.
2. Mr. Siddhartha Bisht, learned A.G.A for the State.
3. Heard.
4. Admit.
5. Call for LCR. 
6. Once the LCR is received, let the paper book be 
prepared and provided to the learned counsel for the 
parties, as per Rules. 
7. Heard the learned counsel for the parties on the 
Exemption Application (IA No.02 of 2026). 
8. Learned Legal Aid Counsel for the appellant has 
filed an exemption application on the ground that he has 
been appointed to provide legal aid to the appellant; he 
may not be in a position to file an affidavit alongwith 
appeal/bail application as well as from filing of court 
fees and memo due to non-availability of any pairokar; 
the applicant/appellant is presently languishing in 
District Jail, Dehradun and as such is unable to sign the 
present appeal/bail application or funish an affidavit in 
support, therefore, he may be exempted to file an 
affidavit, court fees and memo. 9. The Exemption Application is allowed. 
10. List this matter on 30.06.2026.
11. Meanwhile, objections to the Bail Application (IA 
No.01 of 2026) be filed by the State counsel.
(Siddhartha Sah, J.) (Ravindra Maithani, J.) 
 19.05.2026
Akash
